title: Valedictory Session - Destination South India | Virtual Workshop
description:
Destination South India - Virtual Workshop on Hosting U.S. Study Abroad Students aims to build capacity of Indian institutions in South India to design study abroad programs for U.S. university students and to administer these in partnership with U.S. institutions and other Indian partners. The U.S. Consulate General, Chennai in partnership with the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IITM), United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF), and the Forum on Education Abroad will convene a virtual workshop to understand the expectations of U.S. students, U.S. institutions, and Indian institutions, to establish successful study abroad programs. 

The primary goal of the project is to build capacity of Indian institutions to support more American students coming to India to study abroad. This project aims to promote south India as a study abroad destination for students from U.S. institutions and to build capacity of south Indian institutions to foster partnerships with U.S. institutions.
